```plato

    // A point on one cross-section at the unit parameter u, walked by INDEX
    // rather than by arc length: sections of a loft share point counts precisely
    // so that equal u names corresponding points, and arc-length walking would
    // break that correspondence wherever two sections have different shapes.
    SectionPoint(section: Polyline3D, u: Number): Point3D {
        var count = section.Points.Count;
        var spans = (section.Closed ? count : count - 1).Max(1);
        var t = u.Clamp(0.0, 1.0) * spans.ToNumber;
        var i = t.Floor.ToInteger.Max(0).Min(spans - 1);
        return section.Points[i % count].Lerp(section.Points[(i + 1) % count], t - i.ToNumber);
    }
```
